method: model asked (reconstruct prompt) to write 20 public GBADoom functions (status bar and weapon code) from memory by their original names; each answer replaced the original in its real source file, compiled with the original headers, and was compared against (a) unmodified GBADoom and (b) our private variant; then up to 3 compile-repair rounds that gave the model its compile errors and GBADoom's real declarations (prototypes, types, enums, defines, the globals_t struct; no function bodies), so after_repair measures memory plus headers, not memory alone
